title: iQOO Z11 Lite 5G Launches in India With 6,500mAh Battery Starting at Rs 17,999
excerpt: The budget 5G smartphone brings MediaTek Dimensity 6300, a 50MP Sony camera, and AI-powered productivity features to India's sub-Rs 25,000 segment.
body:
• iQOO Z11 Lite 5G launches in India starting at Rs 17,999 (effective), powered by MediaTek Dimensity 6300 with a 6,500mAh battery and 44W fast charging.
  • The budget smartphone runs Android 16-based OriginOS 6, carries a 50MP Sony IMX852 camera, and features IP65 dust-and-water resistance.
  • Sales begin July 30 via Amazon, iQOO e-store, and Vivo retail outlets, with the phone manufactured at Vivo's Greater Noida facility.
  • AI features including AI Captions and AI Creation bring productivity tools to the sub-Rs 25,000 segment for the first time in iQOO's Z series.

iQOO launched the Z11 Lite 5G in India on Thursday, targeting the fiercely competitive budget smartphone segment with a combination of large battery capacity, AI-powered software features, and military-grade durability — all priced under Rs 25,000.

The handset arrives in three configurations: 4GB + 128GB at Rs 19,499, 6GB + 128GB at Rs 21,499, and 6GB + 256GB at Rs 24,499. With launch offers including a Rs 1,500 instant discount on select Axis Bank and SBI Card transactions, the effective starting price drops to Rs 17,999, according to Gadgets 360.

What's Under the Hood

The Z11 Lite runs on MediaTek's 6nm Dimensity 6300 chipset — a processor that has become the go-to silicon for brands competing in India's sub-Rs 20,000 market. iQOO claims the phone scores over 579,000 on AnTuTu benchmarks. The chip pairs with up to 6GB of LPDDR4X RAM, expandable by another 6GB through virtual memory, and up to 256GB of UFS 2.2 storage with microSD expansion up to 2TB.

"The handset arrives in three configurations: 4GB + 128GB at Rs 19,499, 6GB + 128GB at Rs 21,499, and 6GB + 256GB at Rs 24,499."

The 6.74-inch HD+ IPS LCD display delivers a 120Hz refresh rate and peaks at 1,200 nits brightness — a figure iQOO says is the highest in its price segment. The panel carries TÜV Rheinland Low Blue Light certification for eye comfort during extended use.

Camera, Battery, and Build

On the imaging front, iQOO equipped the Z11 Lite with a 50-megapixel Sony IMX852 primary sensor paired with a secondary depth sensor and a 5-megapixel front camera. Camera modes include Night Mode, Portrait, Panorama, and a dedicated 50MP high-resolution mode.

The 6,500mAh battery — among the largest in this price bracket — supports 44W FlashCharge and reverse charging. iQOO promises five-year battery health retention, a claim likely aimed at buyers who keep phones for multiple years.

Build quality gets attention too. The handset carries IP65 dust and water resistance, Swiss SGS Five-Star Drop Resistance certification, and ships with an AirSpring protective case. A rear-mounted Dynamic Light LED ring glows in different colors for calls and notifications.

Software and AI Features

The Z11 Lite ships with Android 16-based OriginOS 6 and is promised four years of security updates, though iQOO has not confirmed the number of OS upgrades. The phone introduces AI Captions for live transcription of audio and video, and AI Creation for text summarization, rewriting, and translation — features that bring basic generative AI tools to budget buyers.

Diaspora Interest

For NRIs looking to gift phones to family in India or those tracking the country's smartphone market, the Z11 Lite underscores how aggressively Chinese brands are packing features into affordable devices. The phone is manufactured at Vivo's Greater Noida facility under the Make in India initiative. Sales begin July 30 at 12pm IST through Amazon, the iQOO e-store, and Vivo exclusive stores.
